candidates.exact_span: Unless otherwise indicated in this permit, if the EPA Region 6 MQL for a pollutant or pollutant parameter is sufficiently sensitive (as defined above) and the analytical test result is less than the MQL, then a value of zero (0) may be used for reporting purposes on DMRs.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Different readings of the carve-out ('unless otherwise indicated'), the external 'sufficiently sensitive' definition, or whether zero is optional versus required for below-MQL results could change which numeric value is compared against enforceable limits (A) and whether a period is treated as a reported zero, a non-detect/no-data state, or ordinary numeric evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: Furthermore, if the EPA Region 6 MQL for a pollutant or parameter is not sufficiently sensitive, but the analytical test result is less than the published ML from a sufficiently sensitive method, then a value of zero (0) may be used for reporting purposes on DMRs.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether this alternate MQL/ML pathway applies determines when below-detection results may be reported as zero; that choice affects limit-exceedance calculations that rely on the reported measurement value (A) and how analytically constrained results are classified relative to missing or non-reportable evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: Under the provisions of Part III.D.7.b.(3) of this permit, violations of daily maximum limitations for the following pollutants shall be reported orally to EPA Region 6, Compliance and Assurance Division, Water Enforcement Branch (6EN-W), Dallas, Texas, and concurrently to NMED
candidates.computation_change_reason: This cross-reference to Part III.D.7.b.(3) and the truncated list of pollutants bearing daily maximum limitations bear on which parameters have enforceable daily maximum limits and how violations are defined; resolving that reference and the omitted pollutant list could change which limit applies and whether an exceedance is identified (A).
